external_collaboration.evidence_quote: On 15–16 October 2026, the LOCATEE consortium gathered in Torres Vedras, Portugal, for a two-day project meeting focused on reviewing progress, strengthening implementation and defining priorities for the project’s final year. Hosted by the Municipality of Torres Vedras, the meeting brought partners together to exchange experiences, address outstanding tasks and coordinate the actions needed to ensure that LOCATEE’s results deliver lasting value for local authorities and communities.

A key focus of the meeting was the implementation of the Energy Poverty Mitigation Services (EPMS) across the three pilot municipalities: Torres Vedras in Portugal, Rumia in Poland and Piraeus in Greece. Partners reviewed progress in each pilot, discussed municipal action plans and coordinated upcoming activities, including stakeholder engagement, workshops, awareness-raising campaigns and the preparation of technical outputs and supporting materials for local authorities.
